No entry offer

Viewers leave without a trace

840k people watched “Why ADHD Makes It So Hard To Date People You Have Chemistry With”. Anyone not ready for coaching had nothing to opt into, so you can’t follow up with them.

No qualifying step

You can’t see who’s ready

No ads

Every lead depends on today’s post

You posted 6 of the last 7 days. All your demand comes from organic reach, so a quiet week means a quiet calendar, and there’s no way to turn spend into booked calls.

Anyone who isn’t ready for 1:1 coaching today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Sound familiar?

The chemistry is instant. So is the anxiety.

  • The people you click with fastest are the ones who leave you feeling unsure.
  • Someone kind and steady shows up, and it feels “boring”.
  • You can’t stop thinking about someone you’ve only known for a few weeks.
  • You can’t tell if what you feel is a gut warning or just nerves.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why chemistry can pull you towards the wrong people

What that instant spark is often made of, and why it can be strongest with people who aren’t a good match.

How ADHD and anxious attachment can feed each other

Why the two together can make early dating feel so intense, and what that looks like day to day.

Limerence: why you get hooked, and how to come back down

Where limerence comes from and the first steps to loosen its grip.

Healthy fear or anxiety?

How to tell a real warning sign apart from the anxiety that shows up in every new connection.

What a secure match actually feels like

What to look for instead, so steady stops feeling like boring.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Script 1 · “Chemistry”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why the people you have the most chemistry with aren’t always the right ones.”

Body

“For a lot of people with ADHD, intensity can feel like connection. Someone unpredictable feels exciting. Someone steady feels flat. That pull is real, but it isn’t always telling you who’s good for you.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live class on it: Why You Keep Choosing the Wrong People. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, same setup as your 840k reel on ADHD and chemistry.

Script 2 · “Limerence”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Can’t stop thinking about someone you’ve only just met? There’s a word for that.”

Body

“It’s called limerence. It can feel like falling in love, but it’s usually more about the uncertainty than the person. Once you understand where it comes from, it gets a lot easier to come back down.”

CTA

“I break it down in my free live class. 60 minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: podcast studio, purple backdrop, white captions like your limerence clips.

Script 3 · “Healthy fear”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A psychologist explains how healthy fear gets mistaken for anxiety.”

Body

“In early dating, every nervous feeling can seem like a warning. Some of them are. Some of them are just anxiety. Learning to tell the two apart changes who you choose, and who you let go.”

CTA

“Join my free live class and I’ll show you how. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, on cream background with serif title card like your 552k reel.
